title: Ye of Little Faith
summary: An air stewardess is found poisoned in her hotel room.
method: The killer knew that the victim liked to write postcards so gifted her with poisoned stamps. A makeup brush was used to apply the poison to the stamps. The later planting of the evidence to frame someone else led to animal hair from the makeup brush found as evidence.
motive: The victim was having an affair with the killer's boyfriend.
killer: Another stewardess who was on a flight when the poisoning occurred.
